texts:
Muse Wonder’s Japanese voxel world looks like it’s built out of marshmallows. 😂

The torii gate and floating island are recognizable, and there’s something charming about the pastel toy-world look. But the chunky shapes and sparse detail make it feel like a first draft.

I’d want another pass before calling this a finished 3D scene.

Meta just dropped Muse Wonder 1, its new frontier AI model.

They're positioning it against Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra, with major improvements in coding and agentic capabilities.

Naturally, I had to throw my Japanese voxel world benchmark at it.

Here's what it built.
